about_the_game: The original soundtrack of Last Time I Saw You. Featuring 19 tracks composed by Laryssa Okada (Manifold Garden, Dorfromantik), this soundtrack will transport you to the melancholic Japanese countryside of the 1980s in which this charming coming-of-age adventure takes place.
